# ROM GUARD

> A dataset about Xiaomi ROM changes focused only on whether they can be undone.
> No ROM distribution or flashing instructions. Nonprofit and advertising-free.

## Policy

- Two permanent failure modes: Anti-Rollback (ARB) violation and EDL (9008) without an authorized Mi Account.
- Never mirror ROM files: redistribution rights, source obligations, and distributor responsibility apply.
- Values require source URLs and verification dates. Leave unverified fields null; the build enforces this.

## Data

- [Devices](https://romguard.pages.dev/data/devices.json): Per-device bootloader unlock, EDL, ARB, FeliCa, and LineageOS data
- [Rules](https://romguard.pages.dev/data/rules.json): Reversibility rules, ROM types, and writable layers
- [Hash records](https://romguard.pages.dev/data/roms.json): SHA-256 records for distributed files, computed locally

## Pages

- [Check](https://romguard.pages.dev/): Checks before flashing
- [Irreversible conditions](https://romguard.pages.dev/risk/): ARB, EDL, and relocking details
- [Hash verification](https://romguard.pages.dev/verify/): Verification steps and the limits of hash checking
- [Devices](https://romguard.pages.dev/devices/): Device list, including unverified fields
- [About](https://romguard.pages.dev/about/): Policy and disclaimer

## Notes

No warranty. Using devices without required local certification may violate applicable radio laws.
